scope: Review of the R2462 permission preview only. No native source, code, tests, or Git changes.

findings: Adds explicit zero-or-more permissions for HAS_ALLOWED_VALUE and HAS_VALUE_CONSTRAINT at both the model `(Node, Node.**)` layer and the instance `($node, $node.**)` layer, matching R2462's existing property-bearing selector structure.
The existing deny-by-default rule remains unchanged; the two named permissions are explicit exceptions only for the direct value Relations.
No permission is added for inverse Relations, HAS_VALUE, or other Relations; no inheritance ban or required-value constraint is loosened.

The Relation declarations reviewed separately admit qualified model Subjects or instances as Hosts. R2247/R2814 provide the narrow literal/constraint-data Target exception; this preview introduces no literal Node or Value Node.

limits: This review validates the proposed source permission shape; it does not claim current activation or runtime behavior.
Relation declaration, endpoint-permission, and CFEL syntax/source adoption remain coordinated gates.
